comment: Region edits on the desktop master. Regions are in pixels on the 1536x1024 master: rect = [left, top, right, bottom], or polygon = [[x, y], ...]. feather = width in px of the soft edge, kept entirely inside the region, so pixels outside it never change. See docs/art/park/refinement-workflow.md.

e3.name: Telephone booth
e3.note: Selection guide was rect [1298, 408, 1452, 712]. Mask narrowed to the new booth's silhouette (+4 px) so the master's own leaves, tree trunk and stone post stay around it; it reaches up to y 401 for the taller roof.

e2.name: Notice board light and separation
e2.note: Was rect [820, 380, 1210, 640]. Narrowed so the mask never touches the fingerpost (post x 897-907, arms to x 967 at y 478-505), the fountain finial (x 880-920 from y 610) or the greenhouse (from x 1190). It covers the board (x 952-1102, y 415-565), the foliage and fallen beam behind it, and the paving in front down to y 625. The notch at x 932-972, y 472-510 leaves the fingerpost arm crossing the board post untouched.

e4.name: Pavilion window
e4.note: Was rect [110, 480, 360, 600]. Measured on v02: window opening x 163-192, y 513-546 (frame ~161-194, 511-548); wooden pillar x 145-158; bench top y 563; door from x 230. The mask is the window plus a narrow band of wall for the light spill, clear of the pillar, bench, door and roof.
